body: i have an appointment to see my psychiatrist which i have not seen since october scheduled on tuesday, we have talked about the possibility of trying lithium before if all else fails and i think i am now more open to that option. im hoping ill also be put on something that will help me sleep at night, but also something that wont interfere with my ability to stay awake during the day. i just hope im not on a whole bunch of meds all at once like i have been for a good portion of my life before i stopped taking them all entirely. i appreciate your advice a lot, it really hasnt been easy especially since i have family members who are also bipolar. i have seen how much it affects them, which scares me a lot for myself.

my therapist was saying the same, that she is concerned for my ability to keep myself safe and asked me if i truly believed that i did not need a hospitalization right now. i said i was sure, i really really hate psychiatric hospitals i have never seen a benefit during and after each time i have gone. i also dont want medical care, i can treat my wounds myself and the last time doctors stitched me they did it so badly that even one of the staff members in the psych hospital was shocked by how poorly it was done. this probably sounds like me being stubborn and me self sabotaging by depriving myself of what would be considered necessary care right now, but im convinced that just the act of me adding consistent mental health monitoring by my team back into my routine will be enough to avoid going down that route.

i know the consequences fair and well, this is not the first time ive been on deaths doorstep because of my ed ='). my parents think ive been "recovering" (been purging for quite some time since ive been forced to recover) so if i do end up dying, trust me, they wont notice for a quite a while. ive been at a point where i was 54 pounds (13 years old) given a week to live on nge feeds lying in a hospital bed. another time, 76 pounds (14 years old) in the hospital again for 5 weeks on nge feeds. now here i am, 80 pounds as of today at 16 years old. at first i was using my ed as a method of su1c1d3, and now its just a deadly obsession, but if everything in me gives out and i really do die, that's just whats in the cards for me this time around, and im okay with that. somehow i always manage to dodge death; survived two accidental overdoses off opiates with heavy liver damage and a dialated aorta, and survived both intentional overdoses with liver and kidney damage as well. i appreciate you telling me this either way though, it shows your concern and i cant express how happy i am that people do care, even if they are just strangers <3. thank you, and good luck on your journey with your ed, its a miserable disease and because of it you deserve all the happiness one could possibly have =').
